name: cf-agent-stacks-x402
description: One-click deployment of an x402 endpoint on Cloudflare that accepts sBTC and STX.

AGENT_PROMPT.description: What your agent does: the system prompt used for every paid question. For example, `You are a Stacks smart-contract tutor.`

AI_MODEL.description: A [Workers AI](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/) text-generation model. Check the model's license before charging for it.

PRICE.description: Price per question, in the token's smallest unit: **sats** for sBTC, **microSTX** for STX (1 STX = 1,000,000).

TOKEN.description: `sBTC` or `STX`: what callers pay you in.

PAY_TO.description: Your Stacks address that receives payments for `/ask` and the paid MCP tool. Use an `ST…` address for testnet or `SP…` for mainnet.

MAX_SATS_PER_PAYMENT.description: For the optional paying agent: the most it will auto-pay for a single call, in sats.
